## Sepia Snake (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
 N Huge magical beast  

**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 22, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +10 natural, -2 size)  

**hp** 114 (12d10+48)  

**Fort** +12, **Ref** +11, **Will** +5  

**DR** 10/magic;  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 50 ft. (good)  

**Melee** bite +17 (1d8+7 plus grab) tail sting +18 (1d8+3 plus poison)  

**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  

**Special Attacks** cocoon, constrict (1d8+10), gaze  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 24, **Dex** 16, **Con** 19, **Int** 4, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 19  

**Base Atk** +12; **CMB** +21; **CMD** 35 (can’t be tripped)  

**Feats** Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Improved Poison, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (tail sting), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  

**Skills** Perception +9, Stealth +12  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Cocoon (Su)** Three times per day, a sepia snake can fire a line of webbing to a range of 20 feet. A creature caught in the path can make a successful DC 20 Reflex save to avoid the web. On a failed save, the opponent is wrapped in the snake’s webbing. When a foe is completely covered in webbing, it must make a successful DC 20 Fortitude save or be placed in a state of suspended animation as per the sepia snake sigil spell for 1d4+12 days. The save DCs are Constitution-based.
